expected_steps.name: Insert dowels into side frames
expected_steps.description: Insert wooden dowels into the pre-drilled holes of the two rectangular side frames.

expected_steps.name: Attach long slatted panels
expected_steps.description: Align and attach the long slatted seat and backrest panels to the dowels on the side frames.

expected_steps.name: Rotate the assembly
expected_steps.description: Rotate the partially assembled bench 90 degrees so that it rests upright on its legs.

expected_steps.name: Secure outer frame with barrel nuts and long bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert barrel nuts into the inner slots of the crossbars and fasten with long bolts through the outer legs using the Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Secure middle support with barrel nuts and pointy bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert barrel nuts into the middle support bar and secure with pointy bolts using the Allen key.

expected_steps.name: Fasten middle seat slats
expected_steps.description: Fasten the middle seat slats to the center support frame using screws and a cross-head screwdriver.
